source.citation: D. Watanabe, H. Manako, T. Onga, T. Tamura, K. Ikeda, M. Isono, 'Combustion Stability Improvement of LE-9 Engine for Booster Stage of H3 Launch Vehicle', Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Technical Review Vol. 53 No. 4 (Aralik 2016), s.30 Tablo 1 'LE-9 engine specifications'
source.extraction_note: Sayilar MHI Technical Review 53(4) PDF Tablo 1'den dogrudan okundu (https://www.mhi.com/technology/review/sites/g/files/jwhtju2326/files/tr/pdf/e534/e534028.pdf): vakum itki 1471 kN, MR (engine mixture rate) 5.9, oda basinci 10.0 MPa, Isp 426 s, genisleme orani 37, cevrim 'expander bleed cycle'. MHI urun sayfasi (mhi.com/business/.../h3-first-stage-engine-le-9) '150 ton' (=1471 kN) ve '425 sec' verir; JAXA H3 sayfasi cevrimi 'expander bleed' teyit eder. [access orijinal etiketi: 'manufacturer_technical_review']

units_original: kN, s, MPa, - (MHI Technical Review 53(4) Tablo 1 orijinal birimleri)
notes: H3 1. kademe ana motoru (JAXA/MHI). Cevrim 'expander bleed' — HRMA cevrim anahtari 'expander' olarak esitlendi (acik/bleed expander; kapali expander degil, adaptor bunu model-formu farki olarak isaretler; bleed dumpi kucuk pozitif Isp sapmasi dogurur). Genisleme orani 37 nispeten dusuk (1. kademe). Ayni MHI Tablo 1 LE-7A (liq-le7a-h2a-spec) ve LE-5B'yi de listeler.
